mapper.insert: insert into coupon(name, amount, min_order_amount, sign_in_day, status, merchant_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{amount}, #{minOrderAmount}, #{signInDay}, #{status}, #{merchantId}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update coupon set name = #{name}, amount = #{amount}, min_order_amount = #{minOrderAmount}, sign_in_day = #{signInDay}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, name, amount, min_order_amount, sign_in_day, status, merchant_id, create_time, update_time from coupon where merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by create_time desc
select id, name, amount, min_order_amount, sign_in_day, status, merchant_id, create_time, update_time from coupon where sign_in_day = #{signInDay} and status = 1 order by create_time desc
select id, name, amount, min_order_amount, sign_in_day, status, merchant_id, create_time, update_time from coupon order by create_time desc
select id, name, amount, min_order_amount, sign_in_day, status, merchant_id, create_time, update_time from coupon where status = #{status} order by create_time desc
mapper.update: update coupon set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
